title: API Error: 400 with "messages.31.content.4.image.source.base64.data: Image does not match the provided media type image/jpeg"
body:
**Bug Description**

I'm using a figma MCP to build UI. API Error: 400 often occurs reading an image. And then, all request returns API Error: 400. Can't do anything.

     image/jpeg"},"request_id":"req_011CVJdbQgf2EuTkf9Qg97pm"}

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.46

top_comments.author: localden
top_comments.body: Thank you for your report — we are currently in the process of triaging MCP-related issues and this one appears to describe the same problem as #11975. To keep the discussion and any fix in one place, we're consolidating into that issue and closing this one. If you have logs, repro steps, or environment details that aren't already covered in #11975, please add them there — it'll help us track this down faster.

top_comments.author: coygeek
top_comments.body:

Both occur when taking an image.
